checks.name: Real Vue product exposes one Google button and no password/role selection
Split login matches desktop, tablet and mobile without overflow
Unconfigured provider shows a safe error without OAuth navigation
Mocked full PKCE callback verifies ordinary shared dashboard despite ADMIN metadata/email
MFA setup is explicit, QR/manual key stay private, and cancellation reviews unfinished setup
MFA wrong code is sanitized and explicit retry reaches AAL2 without a role promotion
Existing authenticator challenges handle expiry and session recovery without cached setup material
Student service dialog traps focus, disables issuance and restores focus on Escape
Disabled or unavailable public service catalog prevents card selection and recovers without a duplicate socket
Owner ticket error and empty states are distinct and private diagnostics stay hidden
Reload has no login flash and waits for mocked getUser and current database context
Authoritative cashier/admin context overrides metadata with existing session
Background queue notifications and focus revalidation preserve the staff tab, draft, search and component
Live tickets use only current public calls, clear after serve/skip, and recover without replacing the dashboard
Staff email search and explicit UUID/counter confirmations preserve existing management controls
Payor tab preserves one live monitor, supports authorized history and responsive layouts
Read-only Google lookup resolves the exact account but cannot activate staff for either role
Missing read capability is truthful and a denied directory cannot revive cached legacy accounts
Revoked role and disabled account immediately clear prior workspace on revalidation
Mock logout and Google account switching cannot retain previous context
Repeated callback reconciles without a second exchange
Cancelled saved sign-in has a terminal recovery error without adopting its SDK session
Mock Google cancellation is scrubbed and grants no workspace
Mock expired code gives generic reconciliation without automatic re-exchange
SDK missing verifier fails locally before any token HTTP request
Callback/login desktop and mobile render without overflow or private canaries
Development password form is isolated at /dev/login
Anonymous /display remains available without Auth controls after callback errors
No unexpected network path, real Auth write, runtime error or Google/hosted contact
